identity: A reader-mail question-and-answer column from the Emirati children's magazine Majid, headed بين ماجد وأصدقائه (Between Majid and his Friends). Two short blurb lines describe the column, then eleven letter-items run in a fixed one-unit-per-line layout: a topic heading, the reader's letter or question, the reader's name, the reader's city and country, then the editor's reply. Register is plain expository MSA aimed at children: short reader questions and short encyclopedia-style answers on non-alignment, print runs, postal codes, Alaska's polar night, the UAE federation, diplomatic number plates, development, Arabian horses and currency rates.
law: The natural sentence unit here is the LINE. Because the layout is one editorial unit per line, almost every sentence end is already pinned by an <NL>, and the whole judgement is about which running lines hide a second sentence and which do not. Four clauses. (1) UNIT LINES ARE ATOMIC. A heading, a personal name, an address or a title line is ONE sentence however many tokens it carries: بيادر وادي السير الأردن ص ب 141242 is a single address unit, not a place sentence plus a P.O.-box sentence, exactly as every other address in the document (كريتر اليمن الديمقراطية / الدار البيضاء المغرب / المدينة المنورة السعودية) is one undivided line. (2) ASYNDETON CUTS. Inside a running line, two syntactically INDEPENDENT finite clauses standing side by side with no connective at all mark a lost full stop, because written Arabic keeps a connective inside a sentence. Asyndeton that is only a modifier does NOT cut: an indefinite noun followed by its bare relative (ليلا يمتد طوال هذه الشهور, a night that extends through these months) is one clause, and a bare list of predicative adjectives (الحصان العربي قوي رشيق جميل سريع) is one clause. (3) WAW CUTS ONLY WHEN IT RESETS THE FRAME. A waw-initial clause is a new sentence when it re-topicalises with a resumptive demonstrative (وهذا الحياد يتميز) or fronts an adverbial that opens a contrasting frame (وفي فصل الصيف). A waw that merely continues the same predication chain about the same topic is a comma, not a period: وأود مبادلتها, وسنصل إلى هذا الرقم, وعاصمتها أبو ظبي, ويكون ضوء النهار ضعيفا, ونسمي هذا الباب. (4) NOTHING ELSE CUTS. Subordinators and relativisers (حيث, لدرجة أن, بمعنى أن, حتى, والذي), the adversative بل, the consequential fa- of فما المقصود بذلك, and interrogatives coordinated under a single terminal question mark all stay inside one sentence. (5) COROLLARY OF (1): a heading physically merged onto the tail of the previous line is still its own sentence and must be cut free.
reasoning: I first fixed what the document IS, because that decides everything: eleven repeating letter-items in a fixed five-slot layout. Once the layout is known, 58 of the 64 boundaries are pinned for free (the 57 pre-<NL> tokens plus the final token 476), and the real work is six contested sites inside running lines. SITE i=146 منحازة, my highest-confidence internal cut. The line ends والذي اشتركت فيه 21 دولة غير منحازة ربع مليون. The trailing ربع مليون is not part of the non-alignment answer at all: it is the HEADING of the next item, proved by the letter that immediately follows it, لماذا لا تزيد عدد النسخ إلى ربع مليون نسخة. Every other item in the document opens with exactly such a heading on its own line (مبادلة, بريد, ألاسكا, النصيحة, الاتحاد, التنمية, الأصيل, الدينار); here the line simply broke late and swallowed the next heading. Corollary (5) fires, so I cut at منحازة. SITE i=96 الغرب. This paragraph runs 51 tokens (77-127), far outside anything else in this register, so at least one full stop was lost, and there is exactly one seam. The definitional clause closes at في الشرق أو الغرب; then وهذا الحياد يتميز restarts with a resumptive demonstrative re-topicalising the very noun just defined. Clause (3) fires. Decisive internal corroboration: the NEXT paragraph literally begins وقد بدأ استعمال, so this writer does open units with waw. Marked med rather than hi because waw-splitting is the genuinely contested class. I declined the other seams inside this paragraph: حيث subordinates, بمعنى أن subordinates, and بل needs the negation before it. SITE i=259 الشهور. The winter description has landed; وفي فصل الصيف fronts a contrasting seasonal frame. Clause (3) fires. I deliberately did NOT cut at i=245 before ويكون ضوء النهار ضعيفا (same topic, chained description, no frame reset), nor at i=255, where يمتد is the bare relative modifying the indefinite ليلا and not an independent clause. Those two refusals are what keep clause (3) from degenerating into cut-at-every-waw. SITE i=264 العكس, the hardest call in the document and the one I am least sure of. تظل الشمس ساطعة على مدار ستة أشهر is a complete independent finite clause juxtaposed with ZERO connective; had the writer wanted it inside the same sentence, fa- was available (fa-tazallu). Clause (2) therefore fires. The counter-argument is real: the clause explicates العكس, and Arabic does use a bare comma or colon for explicative apposition, which would leave no boundary. I cut anyway for consistency with the two clean asyndeton sites, and marked it med. SITES i=302 للنصائح and i=387 سياسية, clean asyndeton, both hi. At 302, لا داعي لتخصيص باب مستقل للنصائح is a complete negative verdict and يمكن نشر هذه الفقرات في باب بأقلام الأصدقاء is a distinct positive alternative. At 387, تحمل هذه الجملة هيئة سياسية states what the plate says and لا يجوز تفتيش السيارة أو القبض على سائقها أو محاكمته إلا في حالات خاصة states what the law forbids: a different assertion, different subject, no connective. REFUSALS worth recording, since precision is what the law is for. i=182 تدريجي: وسنصل إلى هذا الرقم قريبا بإذن الله continues the same promise about the same print run inside a 14-token answer, so comma by clause (3). i=320 واحدة: متى تم توحيد الإمارات في دولة واحدة وما هي عاصمتها is ONE reader query under a single terminal question mark, coordinated interrogatives, clause (4); and I stayed consistent by also refusing i=342, since وعاصمتها أبو ظبي is the appended nominal answering the second half of that same query. i=359: the fa- of فما المقصود بذلك binds the observation to its question. i=32 المجلات: وأود مبادلتها carries a pronoun whose antecedent is the list just given, so a full stop would strand it. i=52 الأردن: address unit, clause (1). i=451: adjective list, the clause (2) exception.
